family: Y / YE Edge Beam (Ireland, beam & slab construction)
description: Irish standard prestressed concrete Y beams (Y1-Y8, 700-1400 mm deep, 750 mm soffit width) and YE edge beams. This module implements the symmetric Y beam; YE (asymmetric edge beam with vertical outer face, Xc ~297-310 mm) is future work.

sources.properties_and_Wf: Banagher Precast Concrete, Bridge Beam Manual, 3rd ed., printed pp. 32-33 (sources/banagher-bridge-beam-manual-3ed.pdf); identical tables in Concast civil brochure (sources/concast-civil-brochure.pdf) and in '05316 Precast Beam Properties.xls' (2007).
sources.strand_layout: Banagher manual printed p. 33: 'Y Beam Showing All Possible Strand Locations - In all beams superimposed'.

fit.note: Manufacturers publish Wf, properties and strand layouts but not internal dimensions. The internal geometry below is a least-squares reconstruction fitted to the published area, centroid and second moment of area of all eight sizes (24 values, direct relative errors). Units mm. Origin: mid-soffit, y up.

strand_note: Row heights are mm above soffit. Published spread dims (70, 100, 130, 160, 190, 220, 250, 305, 320 at rows 480-1330, marked 'published': true) imply a linear spread law spread(y) = 70 + 0.2941*(y - 480); unmarked rows are interpolated at that law. Strand positions are distributed uniformly within each row spread; manufacturers place strands at non-uniform pitches within the bottom flange rows (see 'note' on the 60 mm row). 'All beams superimposed' - filter rows to those below a beam's depth minus top cover before use.
